cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory Technician to join our Asphalt Group.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Our Team
This is a team-based environment that collaborates with operations and technical team members and participates in various meetings with business partners. Effectively communicating between teams, promoting collaboration, and setting a tone of partnership ensures good stewardship and compliance as we make quality products to consistently meet customer expectations.
What You Will Do
Performing a variety of laboratory test methods in an efficient and accurate manner in accordance with regulatory agency standards
Maintaining laboratory equipment health by performing calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair tasks
Participating in a defined QA/QC program to determine precision and accuracy of test measurement systems
Maintaining laboratory data within a LIMS database
Analyzing laboratory data for trends and recommending action accordingly
Providing training, daily direction and oversight to seasonal laboratory technicians
Maintaining a clean and organized laboratory space and monitoring laboratory consumable materials and supplies levels to ensure adequately stock
Serving as a liaison between operations and technical team members
Driving improvements by profitably applying innovation
Periodic travel to support network of laboratories, participate in team meetings and attend development events
Physical Considerations:
Physical ability to frequently stand and balance.
Physical ability to occasionally sit, walk, lift, carry, push, pull, reach, bend, and twist.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds (with frequent carrying of up to 25 pounds)
Is able to respond to audio alarms, or other loud noises that would indicate a safety concern
Must be able to communicate hazardous conditions and other dangers
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A valid driver's license
2+ Years laboratory experience (academic or industry)
Willing and able to meet physical requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science-related field such as Chemistry or Engineering, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Experience testing asphaltic material or similar materials
Experience maintaining laboratory equipment health (calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair)
This role is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

cond_0163.responsibilities:
Our Team

Is able to respond to audio alarms, or other loud noises that would indicate a safety concern
Must be able to communicate hazardous conditions and other dangers
cond_0163.requirements:

A valid driver's license
2+ Years laboratory experience (academic or industry)
Willing and able to meet physical requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science-related field such as Chemistry or Engineering, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Experience testing asphaltic material or similar materials
Experience maintaining laboratory equipment health (calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair)

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician to join our Asphalt Group.
This is a team-based environment that collaborates with operations and technical team members and participates in various meetings with business partners. Effectively communicating between teams, promoting collaboration, and setting a tone of partnership ensures good stewardship and compliance as we make quality products to consistently meet customer expectations.
cond_0290.responsibilities:
Performing a variety of laboratory test methods in an efficient and accurate manner in accordance with regulatory agency standards
Maintaining laboratory equipment health by performing calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair tasks
Participating in a defined QA/QC program to determine precision and accuracy of test measurement systems
Maintaining laboratory data within a LIMS database
Analyzing laboratory data for trends and recommending action accordingly
Providing training, daily direction and oversight to seasonal laboratory technicians
Maintaining a clean and organized laboratory space and monitoring laboratory consumable materials and supplies levels to ensure adequately stock

Driving improvements by profitably applying innovation

Physical Considerations:
Physical ability to frequently stand and balance.

Is able to respond to audio alarms, or other loud noises that would indicate a safety concern
Must be able to communicate hazardous conditions and other dangers
cond_0290.requirements:

A valid driver's license
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated laboratory expertise (academic or industry)
Bachelor's degree in a science-related field such as Chemistry or Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Proven ability to meet the physical requirements of the role
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of testing asphaltic material or similar materials
Proven track record maintaining laboratory equipment health, including calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair

cond_0343.intro: We are looking for a Laboratory Technician to join our Asphalt Group.
cond_0343.responsibilities:
Our Team
This is a team-based environment that collaborates with operations and technical team members and participates in various meetings with business partners. Effectively communicating between teams, promoting collaboration, and setting a tone of partnership ensures good stewardship and compliance as we make quality products to consistently meet customer expectations.
What You Will Do
Performing a variety of laboratory test methods in an efficient and accurate manner in accordance with regulatory agency standards
Maintaining laboratory equipment health by performing calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair tasks
Participating in a defined QA/QC program to determine precision and accuracy of test measurement systems
Maintaining laboratory data within a LIMS database
Analyzing laboratory data for trends and recommending action accordingly
Providing training, daily direction and oversight to seasonal laboratory technicians
Maintaining a clean and organized laboratory space and monitoring laboratory consumable materials and supplies levels to ensure adequately stock
Serving as a liaison between operations and technical team members
Driving improvements by profitably applying innovation
Periodic travel to support network of laboratories, participate in team meetings and attend development events
Physical Considerations:
Physical ability to frequently stand and balance.
Physical ability to occasionally sit, walk, lift, carry, push, pull, reach, bend, and twist.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds (with frequent carrying of up to 25 pounds)
Is able to respond to audio alarms, or other loud noises that would indicate a safety concern
Must be able to communicate hazardous conditions and other dangers
cond_0343.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A valid driver's license
2+ Years laboratory experience (academic or industry)
Willing and able to meet physical requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science-related field such as Chemistry or Engineering, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Experience testing asphaltic material or similar materials
Experience maintaining laboratory equipment health (calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair)
This role is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Our Team
This is a team-based environment that collaborates with operations and technical team members and participates in various meetings with business partners. Effectively communicating between teams, promoting collaboration, and setting a tone of partnership ensures good stewardship and compliance as we make quality products to consistently meet customer expectations.
cond_0514.responsibilities:
Performing a variety of laboratory test methods in an efficient and accurate manner in accordance with regulatory agency standards
Maintaining laboratory equipment health by performing calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair tasks
Participating in a defined QA/QC program to determine precision and accuracy of test measurement systems
Maintaining laboratory data within a LIMS database
Analyzing laboratory data for trends and recommending action accordingly
Providing training, daily direction and oversight to seasonal laboratory technicians
Maintaining a clean and organized laboratory space and monitoring laboratory consumable materials and supplies levels to ensure adequately stock
Serving as a liaison between operations and technical team members
Driving improvements by profitably applying innovation
Periodic travel to support network of laboratories, participate in team meetings and attend development events
Physical Considerations:
Physical ability to frequently stand and balance.
Physical ability to occasionally sit, walk, lift, carry, push, pull, reach, bend, and twist.
Ability to lift up to 50 pounds (with frequent carrying of up to 25 pounds)
Is able to respond to audio alarms, or other loud noises that would indicate a safety concern
Must be able to communicate hazardous conditions and other dangers
cond_0514.requirements:
A valid driver's license
2+ Years laboratory experience (academic or industry)
Willing and able to meet physical requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science-related field such as Chemistry or Engineering, etc.
Experience testing asphaltic material or similar materials
Experience maintaining laboratory equipment health (calibration, preventative maintenance, troubleshoot, repair)
This role is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship
cond_0514.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0514.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workplace where people can grow, connect, and build their careers with confidence. Employees have access to knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-development resources designed to support growth over time.
